notes: Found by running 4.3.0's own new check against a healthy machine. automation.daily_ledger reported *"no momw weight vector has ever been recorded here"* on an instance that had been recording vectors all day. The register is {symbols: {SYM: [{date, ...}]}}. The check walked the TOP level, got the single key symbols, found it was not an array, and concluded nothing had ever been written. So the one check whose entire job is to notice a job that stopped would have warned permanently — and a check that cries wolf forever is worse than no check, because it teaches the reader to ignore the one sign
